subject: Cornerstone — CEO meeting: access, staging & EA coordination
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@cornerstone.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cornerstone.com
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CEO visit — proposed dates and initial questions

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for coordinating. Martin (our CEO) will be in SF the week of March 20 and we
would like to schedule a 90-minute strategic briefing with Redwood leadership plus a tour of
your in-house ops. Proposed slots: Tue 3/21 morning or Wed 3/22 late morning.

A few quick asks to help our EA + travel team:
- Can you confirm main point of contact on your side for arrival escort and secure building
  access?
- Do you require a pre-registration/security form from visitors? If so, please flag any
  fields that require legal company info.
- Any dietary constraints for internal hosts we should consider for the working lunch?

I attached Martin's current flight times (subject to change) and our security intake form.
Let me know which slot works and who we should send the attendee list to.

Best,
Anna
Anna Keller | Executive Assistant to Martin Hale
Cornerstone Analytics

Attachments: cornerstone_ceo_itinerary.pdf, cornerstone_security_form.pdf

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: CEO visit — proposed dates and initial questions

Anna — thanks, very helpful. We can host Tue 3/21 at 10:00 AM (90 minutes) — hold that
slot provisionally.

Quick answers / next steps:
- Point of contact for arrival escort & badges: Marissa Cole (cc'd). She will meet the party
  in the lobby and handle temporary badge issuance.
- Yes — we need the completed security intake (the one you attached) plus a scanned ID for
  the CEO for building access; if Cornerstone prefers, security@cornerstone.com can push the
  completed form back to us.
- Lunch: please flag any vegetarian or severe allergies. We typically provide mixed hot
  entrees and a gluten-free option.

I've attached a draft agenda for the 90-minute briefing. Marissa will follow up with the
run-of-show and AV checklist. If Martin's flight arrives early, we can offer a short pre-brief
(30 minutes) in a private room.

My cell is +1 (415) 555-0194 for day-of coordination.

Thanks,
Avery
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_agenda_v1.docx

  Security desk will have pre-printed passes for Martin, Elena & Ravi).

reschedule or phone-in from the airport (we will set up a secure line).

Attached is the EA run-of-show and the AV checklist. I'll update the calendar invite after
driver confirmation.

Marissa
Executive Assistant — Redwood Inference
